name: What are the latest trends in luxury pool and outdoor living design?

mainEntity.name: What are the latest trends in luxury pool and outdoor living design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current trends in luxury pool and outdoor living design focus on creating integrated, multi-functional spaces. This includes clean-line, minimalist pool designs, often with infinity edges or zero-entry features. Natural materials like stone and wood are popular for decking and surrounding elements. Smart technology integration for lighting, climate, and entertainment is common, as are outdoor kitchens, sophisticated landscaping, and water features that double as art. Sustainability, through efficient systems and native plantings, is also a growing consideration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Latest trends include minimalist designs, natural materials, integrated smart technology, multi-functional outdoor kitchens, and sustainable practices.
